SET @prov_c := ( SELECT provincecode FROM sys_config LIMIT 1 ); SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1); SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001'); SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930'); SET @end_d2:=concat(@b_year,'0229'); DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tx; CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tx( SELECT p.hospcode,p.PID,p.CID, p.NAME, p.LNAME, p.SEX , p.BIRTH, p.HID, p.addr, p.check_vhid, p.NATION, p.TYPEAREA ,t.l_hospcode,t.l_date_serv ,t.f_hospcode,t.f_date_serv ,DATE_SUB(t.l_date_serv,INTERVAL 6 MONTH) l_visit ,REPLACE(REPLACE(t.g_visit,'","HOSPCODE"' ,'"
"HOSPCODE"'),'"','') g_visit ,IF(t.visit6m IN(1),'ได้รับการติดตาม','') result FROM tmp_f20_viy_cidr t INNER JOIN chospital h ON INSTR( t.g_visit,concat('"HOSPCODE":"',h.hoscode,'"')) AND h.provcode IN(@prov_c) INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON INSTR( t.g_visit,concat('"HOSPCODE":"',p.hospcode,'"')) AND t.cid=p.cid WHERE LENGTH(t.cid)=13 AND t.nation IN(99) AND t.age_y>=15 AND t.l_date_serv BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d AND LENGTH(f_hospcode)=5 ); SELECT h.hoscode, h.hosname, d.PID, d.CID, d.NAME, d.LNAME, d.SEX , d.BIRTH, d.HID, d.addr, d.check_vhid, d.NATION, d.TYPEAREA ,d.f_hospcode,d.f_date_serv ,d.l_hospcode,d.l_date_serv ,d.g_visit,d.result,d.l_visit FROM tx d INNER JOIN chospital h ON d.hospcode = h.hoscode WHERE 1=1 {where}

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("target") as "target" ,SUM("result") as "result"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
